description: This file defines an abstract base class for image generation services within an AI-powered image generation system. It specifies an interface for subclasses to implement the actual image creation logic based on text prompts, and handles processing of frames for the system.

classes.name: ImageGenService
classes.description: An abstract base class for AI-powered image generation services. It processes frames by using text prompts to generate images through subclass implementations.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_image_gen(self, prompt: str)
methods.description: Abstract method to generate images from text prompts; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Handles processing of frames, using text frames as prompts and managing the image generation process.
